newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Ciampi to hold 1500 GMT news conference.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Ciampi to hold 1500 GMT news conference.

text.p: Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi will hold a news conference at 4.0 p.m. (1500 GMT) on Monday to present revised statistics for 1992-1996 following the recent reclassification of Italian accounts by Eurostat.
State auditor Andrea Monorchio and Treasury Director General Mario Draghi will be present at the news conference, the Treasury said in a statement.

Eurostat, the European Union office responsible for overseeing government accounting practices, last Friday approved a number of Italian budgetary moves aimed at reducing the ratio between the state deficit and gross domestic product.
